messages:
maya: Alert: libssl CVE-2026-1234 found in the runtime base image used by Dedicated. Patch small but affects live hosts. Need minimal rebuild + KMS cosign + auditable signer SA + tight canary tomorrow 09:30 PT.

liam: Inventory ask: which services mount runtime rootfs? Need blast-radius list.

anika: I can add CI job to produce SBOM + reproducible build. Will use cosign KMS plugin and produce attestation bundle.

ron: IAM guidance: create ephemeral signer SA with kms.sign only; avoid iam.serviceAccounts.signBlob. Scope RoleBinding to build-runner ns.

security-bot: Scan alert: redwood/runtime:latest -> CVE-2026-1234 severity=HIGH. Report: https://scans.internal/reports/3399 :warning:

maya: Proposed steps - 1) ephemeral signer SA + RoleBinding (ron); 2) CI build + SBOM + cosign bundle (anika); 3) push tagged image to staging (anika); 4) canary on 3 Dedicated nodes (liam); 5) monitor metrics & audit logs, rollback on regressions (maya).

anika: CI snippet I'll add:
./ci/build-runtime --minimal --sbom out/sbom.json --out gcr.io/redwood/staging/rebase-libssl-1749998888
cosign sign --key k8s://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/cosign --output-bundle out/cosign.bundle
Runner needs kms.sign on signer SA.

liam: I'll own the canary: reserve 3 Dedicated machines, tag them canary-libssl, create zero-downtime restart checklist. Need image push window.

ron: Filing IAM ticket for 4h ephemeral signer SA. Will add audit-log filter for serviceAccounts:signBlob and kms.cryptoKeyVersions.sign to sec-logging.

security-bot: Reminder: attach SBOM to cosign bundle so provenance is preserved.

maya: I'll draft rollback playbook and dashboards for latency/error/token-cost. 09:15 PT quick sync before canary.

deploy-bot: Job queued: staging-rebase-libssl-1749998888 by anika, ETA ~2h.

anika: Uploaded runbook: https://docs.internal/runbooks/rebase-libssl-1749998888 and PR: https://git.internal/redwood/ci/pull/501.

maya: tagging @oncall and eng-runtime. Final go/no-go 30m before start. Thanks :thumbsup:
